## Methods

IL-6 (pg/mL) was compared between the two groups with a Mann-Whitney U test. Normality was assessed with the Shapiro-Wilk test. A non-parametric test was used because the normality assumption was not met. Effect size is reported as rank-biserial r = -0.85. Significance was set at P < 0.05. Analyses were performed in R 4.4.1 with rstatix 0.7.2; figures were produced with ggpubr 0.6.0 and ggprism 1.0.5. Group sizes were n = 12 and n = 12.
